```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Assuming 'clean_df' already has:
# - PC1_mean
# - avg_volume_estimated

# - Ecology (optional)


```

# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import
# Load your files
eco <- read_csv("Results/Ecology/Ecology_from_tree.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

pca <- read_csv("Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

vol <- read_csv("Results/Volume/Volume.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

loc <- read_csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date_Precipitation_monthly_cm.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

clim <- read.csv("Results/Climate/Amanita_Climate_Summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

# Merge all
df <- pca %>% left_join(vol, by = "species") %>% left_join(eco, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(clim, by = "species")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    log_precip = log10(Precipitation_monthly_cm + 1e-6),  # small constant to avoid log(0)
    log_volume = log10(avg_volume_estimated)
  )

```


```{r}

# PC1 ~ Precip
cor_pc1 <- cor.test(df$Precipitation_monthly_cm, df$PC1_mean, method = "pearson")
r_pc1 <- round(cor_pc1$estimate, 2)
p_pc1 <- format.pval(cor_pc1$p.value, digits = 4, eps = 0.001)

# PC1 ~ Precip
cor_pc1_log <- cor.test(df$log_precip, df$PC1_mean, method = "pearson")
r_pc1_log <- round(cor_pc1$estimate, 2)
p_pc1_log <- format.pval(cor_pc1$p.value, digits = 4, eps = 0.001)

# Volume ~ Precip
cor_vol <- cor.test(df$Precipitation_monthly_cm, df$avg_volume_estimated, method = "pearson")
r_vol <- round(cor_vol$estimate, 2)
p_vol <- format.pval(cor_vol$p.value, digits = 4, eps = 0.001)


```

```{r}

plot_pc1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Precipitation_monthly_cm, y = PC1_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           label = paste0("r = ", r_pc1, ", p = ", p_pc1), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Spore Shape (PC1) vs. Precipitation",
    x = "30-day Precipitation (cm)",
    y = "Mean PC1 (Spore Shape Axis)"  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )


```


```{r}
plot_volume <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Precipitation_monthly_cm, y = avg_volume_estimated)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", 
           x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           label = paste0("r = ", r_vol, ", p = ", p_vol), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Spore Volume vs. Precipitation",
    x = "30-day Precipitation (mm)",
    y = "Estimated Spore Volume"  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

```


```{r}


ggsave("Figure_PC1_vs_Precip.png", plot = plot_pc1, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figure_Volume_vs_Precip.png", plot = plot_volume, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```
